chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from one who narrated it from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Al-wisal (continuous fasting) in fasting is when he makes his evening meal his pre-dawn meal."

key_terms.الْوِصَالُ: Continuous fasting without breaking the fast at night

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of al-wisal in Shia fasting jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that 'al-wisal' specifically refers to delaying the evening meal (isha') until the pre-dawn meal (suhoor), thereby linking the two without a distinct dinner break. This definition distinguishes the practice from merely skipping dinner, highlighting the juristic nuance in Shia fiqh regarding the continuity of the fast. The narration underscores the importance of intention and meal timing in maintaining the spiritual and physical integrity of the fast.
